# Fixture for CWE-772 (safe): socket ownership transferred to connection object
# (self.sock = sock) — lifecycle owner closes the resource (niquests unixsocket).
lang: python
file: extensions/unixsocket/__init__.py
---
import socket


class UnixHTTPConnection:
    def connect(self):
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        sock.settimeout(self.timeout)
        sock.connect(self.socket_path)
        self.sock = sock
        self._post_conn()
